item.title: Trump Administration to Return Diplomats to Middle East Embassies
item.description: Evacuated foreign service officers could begin heading back to their posts as early as this week, an internal document shows, suggesting Washington does not anticipate a renewal of full-scale conflict with Iran.

item.title: U.S. Campaign on Iran’s Economy May Still Risk Regional Military Escalation
item.description: Experts warn that a campaign aimed at avoiding military escalation could instead provoke it, as Iranian leaders vow retaliation across the oil-rich Gulf.

item.title: What We Know About Australia’s Bird Flu, Which Has Crossed Over to Mammals
item.description: Australia confirmed its first case of H5N1 in June in migratory seabirds. Since then, the virus has spread rapidly, straining government responses.

item.title: How U.S.-Canada Tariff Negotiations Turned Into an All-Out Trade War
item.description: Detailed accounts of the final hours of the negotiations show that, while the United States offered Canada what it said was the best deal of any country, what Canada had to give up in exchange was seen as unthinkable.

item.title: Christian Convert Who Fled Iran and Was Deported By Trump Finds New Home
item.description: Artemis Ghasemzadeh, who had escaped religious persecution, was deported to Panama under Trump’s immigration crackdown. Now, Canada has given her asylum.

item.title: Where Iran’s Young People Gather, the Government Sees Threats to Its Authority
item.description: In recent weeks, the police have closed dozens of cafes, often citing laws that stipulate women must veil in public. Experts say the closures are part of an effort to control public space.

item.title: Iran Pledges to Defy Trump’s Economic Sanctions
item.description: Analysts say Tehran could intensify the dispute militarily after the United States announced new efforts to squeeze Iran’s economy. One Iranian official vowed that “not a single drop of oil” would leave the gulf.

item.title: A New Effort to Punish Iran
item.description: The Trump administration says it will try to cut the country off from the global economy by targeting its trading partners.

item.title: Syria and Israel Hold U.S.-Mediated Talks to Try to Ease Tensions
item.description: The discussions, reported by the Syrian state news agency, came days after Israel struck an air base in Syria’s northwest, the latest in a series of military interventions.

item.title: UK Prime Minister Burnham Arrives in Ukraine as Russia Amps Up Warnings
item.description: In his first foreign trip since taking office, the British prime minister pledged to stand by Kyiv despite new warnings of potential consequences.
